items.text: Introduced a trust system for livestock: hanging around cows builds trust, allowing you to lead them, and bulls can become neutral or protective, paving the way for domestication and future bull armies.
Mothers now defend their calves when they are hurt, adding new defensive wildlife behavior.
Fixed a tool cupboard replication bug that could cause the cupboard to not function correctly across the network.

2026-09-05.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Introduced a trust system for livestock: hanging around cows builds trust, allowing you to lead them, and bulls can become neutral or protective, paving the way for domestication and future bull armies.
- Mothers now defend their calves when they are hurt, adding new defensive wildlife behavior.

### Base & Structures
- Fixed a tool cupboard replication bug that could cause the cupboard to not function correctly across the network.

items.text: Cows now remember being attacked and can kick when you get too close while fleeing; calves run faster to keep up with their mothers.
Livestock AI improvements: grazing fullness decay fixed, drink rate restored, starving animals can roam for food, path resets prevented on unplaced agents, and cows idle/rest behavior corrected.
Fixed livestock fixtures breaking with the new navmesh and corrected AI state handling for livestock.
Fixed AI kicking action not working.
Crocodiles now correctly enter the onNavmesh state, fixing their movement and spawning behavior.
Added a new achievement for inserting a heavy fuse into the power plant and improved tracking of which player moves items for accurate achievement and analytics.
Introduced building grade, localization, and an upgrade command for the Scrap King building skin, expanding DLC building functionality.
Paintball gun now correctly updates its colour when equipped.
Fixed arrow reloading bug where switching to a different arrow type caused arrows to load before the arrowhead.
Store UI stability fixes: added a loading blocker when the store isn’t fully warmed up and repaired a crash when pressing store items.
Guide mesh fixes improve building placement accuracy for many structures (boat station, wind turbine, tripod spotlight, small engine, tier‑3 workbench, cannon, sail, chandelier, planters).
Character creator FOV issue resolved, giving a wider view when customizing your character.
Bee grenade visual drift and clipping fixed, ensuring the grenade and its bees render correctly.

2026-09-04.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Cows now remember being attacked and can kick when you get too close while fleeing; calves run faster to keep up with their mothers.
- Livestock AI improvements: grazing fullness decay fixed, drink rate restored, starving animals can roam for food, path resets prevented on unplaced agents, and cows idle/rest behavior corrected.
- Fixed livestock fixtures breaking with the new navmesh and corrected AI state handling for livestock.
- Fixed AI kicking action not working.
- Crocodiles now correctly enter the onNavmesh state, fixing their movement and spawning behavior.

### Achievements
- Added a new achievement for inserting a heavy fuse into the power plant and improved tracking of which player moves items for accurate achievement and analytics.

### Scrap King Building DLC
- Introduced building grade, localization, and an upgrade command for the Scrap King building skin, expanding DLC building functionality.

### Weapons & Items
- Paintball gun now correctly updates its colour when equipped.
- Fixed arrow reloading bug where switching to a different arrow type caused arrows to load before the arrowhead.

### Store UI
- Store UI stability fixes: added a loading blocker when the store isn’t fully warmed up and repaired a crash when pressing store items.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Guide mesh fixes improve building placement accuracy for many structures (boat station, wind turbine, tripod spotlight, small engine, tier‑3 workbench, cannon, sail, chandelier, planters).
- Character creator FOV issue resolved, giving a wider view when customizing your character.
- Bee grenade visual drift and clipping fixed, ensuring the grenade and its bees render correctly.

items.text: Cows now age: they slow down, sleep peacefully, die of old age instead of combat death, and exhibit new behaviors like lying down, regrouping at night, and reduced roaming.
Fixed gen2 AI (including livestock) not updating its position in the brain grid, improving AI movement and spatial queries.
Animal fences now play new sound effects when interacted with.
Added half‑height and three‑quarter‑height sandbag barricade variants for more building flexibility.
Compster and stove no longer show incorrect “Turn on/Turn off” menu options.
Removed occasional ghost character in the character creator caused by SSS.
Store UI now handles null or no selection without errors, preventing crashes when browsing items.
Train headlight beams now pool correctly and train car audio resets properly, fixing visual and sound glitches on trains.
Grenade client prediction now realigns with the server and fixes immediate release mode bugs, improving grenade accuracy.
Flamethrower canister drop now shows a realistic ground impact effect.
Floating light bug on large oil rigs fixed, removing stray light.
Added null checks to prevent crashes when sounds are missing.
Added safeguards against null particle systems in PowergridEngineFx, reducing crash risk.
Fixed motion blur issues with Crystal AR, improving visual clarity during fast movement.
Corrected LOD chain errors across many prefabs, preventing objects from disappearing or rendering incorrectly at distance.
Livestock now spawn with coats that can be harvested for resources, and their corpses and newborns persist across server restarts.
Thrown items no longer have an incorrect offset, restoring normal throw trajectories.

2026-09-03.summary:
### Livestock & Animals
- Cows now age: they slow down, sleep peacefully, die of old age instead of combat death, and exhibit new behaviors like lying down, regrouping at night, and reduced roaming.
- Fixed gen2 AI (including livestock) not updating its position in the brain grid, improving AI movement and spatial queries.
- Animal fences now play new sound effects when interacted with.

### Buildings & Base Items
- Added half‑height and three‑quarter‑height sandbag barricade variants for more building flexibility.

### UI & Menus
- Compster and stove no longer show incorrect “Turn on/Turn off” menu options.
- Removed occasional ghost character in the character creator caused by SSS.
- Store UI now handles null or no selection without errors, preventing crashes when browsing items.

### Vehicles
- Train headlight beams now pool correctly and train car audio resets properly, fixing visual and sound glitches on trains.

### Combat & Weapons
- Grenade client prediction now realigns with the server and fixes immediate release mode bugs, improving grenade accuracy.
- Flamethrower canister drop now shows a realistic ground impact effect.

### World Visuals
- Floating light bug on large oil rigs fixed, removing stray light.

### Bug Fixes & Stability
- Added null checks to prevent crashes when sounds are missing.
- Added safeguards against null particle systems in PowergridEngineFx, reducing crash risk.
- Fixed motion blur issues with Crystal AR, improving visual clarity during fast movement.
- Corrected LOD chain errors across many prefabs, preventing objects from disappearing or rendering incorrectly at distance.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Livestock now spawn with coats that can be harvested for resources, and their corpses and newborns persist across server restarts.

### Bug Fixes
- Thrown items no longer have an incorrect offset, restoring normal throw trajectories.
